name: University of Oxford
shortDescription: One of the world's oldest and most prestigious universities, strong across nearly every subject.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Exceptional reputation, high tuition, strong career doors across all fields.

name: University of Cambridge
shortDescription: World-leading research university with an exceptional academic reputation.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Elite reputation and research strength, especially in sciences and engineering.

name: Imperial College London
shortDescription: Specialist in science, engineering, medicine, and business — strong industry links.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Best fit for STEM careers, especially tech and engineering employers.

name: University College London (UCL)
shortDescription: Large, diverse research university in central London with broad subject strength.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Strong across a wide subject range, benefits from a central London location.

name: London School of Economics (LSE)
shortDescription: Specialist social science institution, globally known for economics, finance, and politics.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: The strongest choice specifically for finance, economics, and policy careers.

name: University of Manchester
shortDescription: One of the UK's largest research-intensive universities with a strong global brand.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Strong balance of reputation and tuition cost, large alumni network.

name: King's College London
shortDescription: Central London university especially strong in medicine, law, and humanities.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Strong for medicine, law, and humanities, with a prime London location.

name: University of Edinburgh
shortDescription: Scotland's leading research university with a broad, strong subject range.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: High reputation with comparatively lower living costs than London.

name: University of Bristol
shortDescription: Research-intensive university known for engineering, sciences, and student experience.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Strong engineering programs at a more moderate cost than London universities.

name: University of Leeds
shortDescription: Large Russell Group university known for strong student support and research.

comparisonHighlights.tagline: Good all-round value — solid reputation with lower living costs than London.
